What is one-step-seo? It is a one-command SEO and AI-visibility audit. In short: run one command and get two scores with fixes.

Features

  • Technical checks
  • On-page checks

FAQ

How do I run it? With npx one-step-seo audit https://example.com

Related page Pricing

Each audit reads the page the way a search crawler does, then checks the title, description, headings, images, links and structured data. Every finding comes with a severity, a plain explanation and a suggested fix, so you know what to change first. The search score and the AI visibility score stay separate on purpose, because a page can rank well and still be hard for answer engines to quote. Run the audit again after each change to confirm the fix worked.
